character.name: Yemmel Knagg
character.background: Hermit druid, returned from decades in a black fen to warn settlements of an approaching doom.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Yemmel makes leaves whisper, soil crack, or small natural omens bloom to warn or signal others.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.description: A flame dances in Yemmel's palm, shedding light and able to be hurled at an enemy.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping roots and vines erupt to restrain enemies while Yemmel calls for flight or repentance.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.description: Ten bitter berries appear, each carrying enough nourishment and a spark of healing for a long road.

traits: Gnome Cunning: advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.
Druidic: understands the secret druidic tongue and can leave hidden nature-signs for other druids.
Spellcasting: channels primal magic through wisdom, preparing rites of root, omen, and warning.
Doom-Hermit: reads rot, weather, and animal silence as portents of coming ruin.
character.gear: Gnarled Rowan Staff · Moss-eaten Hide Armor · Dried bogberries (5) · Healing potion · Antlered Mistletoe Talisman · Resin torches (3) · Ash-inked Omen Scroll
character.story: For forty seasons, Yemmel Knagg listened to the roots beneath Vessermoor. At first the whispers were only rot and rain, then they became a single word: soon. The birds left. The bog-stars drowned. When his grove turned to black glass, the little gnome climbed out of the hollow for the first time in decades, carrying warnings no one asked for. Now he walks among towns, mud on his boots and prophecy on his tongue, seeking ears that will hear before the doom beneath the world opens its patient mouth.

inventory.name: Gnarled Rowan Staff
inventory.lore: Cut from a rowan that survived the Ashfall of Vessermoor, its bark still smells of old smoke.
inventory.description: A druid's quarterstaff, darkened by age and fen-water.

inventory.name: Moss-eaten Hide Armor
inventory.lore: Stitched from the shed hide of a bog-elk, it kept Yemmel dry through forty seasons of black rain.
inventory.description: Crude but sturdy armor made from hide, moss, and sinew.

inventory.name: Dried Bogberries
inventory.lore: Gathered from the Thornmere, where berries grow only where drowned trees bloom.
inventory.description: Bitter dried berries that sustain a traveler when better food is gone.
inventory.effects: Sustains a small creature for half a day.

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: A gift from a dying marsh-priest who asked Yemmel to carry his last warning to the surface.
inventory.description: A small clay vial of red-green liquid smelling of crushed nettles.

inventory.name: Antlered Mistletoe Talisman
inventory.lore: Carved from mistletoe and antler-shard, it hums faintly when birds abandon a valley.
inventory.description: A druidic focus shaped from antler, mistletoe, and knotted root.
inventory.effects: Can be used as a druidic focus.

inventory.name: Resin Torches
inventory.lore: Wrapped in resin from the Weeping Pines, their flame burns green in foul air.
inventory.description: Sturdy torches bound with sticky pine resin.
inventory.effects: Burns for 1 hour, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius.

inventory.name: Ash-inked Omen Scroll
inventory.lore: Ink mixed with grave-ash records the seasons Yemmel spent listening to dying roots.
inventory.description: A brittle scroll covered in ash-dark symbols and root-maps.
inventory.effects: Reveals Yemmel's omens when read aloud.
